message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout during a storm. I felt a bit like a gloriously over-prepared squirrel as I unearthed my stash of flashlights and power banks. I even had a lantern ready for some cozy vibes. While others were scrambling, we enjoyed board games by the warm glow and charged our phones without a hitch. Turns out, being ready can turn a minor inconvenience into a little adventure. What’s your favorite way to stay cozy during a power outage?
